title: ID0419712-DC/Si-D/FR-{Y2 / S2 313522141002}Connector is unavailable
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
One of the connectors currently appears to be unavailable. Additionally, the client has reported some irregular behavior from the station, including a case where a truck was only charged up to 40%, after which the charging session unexpectedly stopped.
Solution:
Query answered, No response from customer.

additional_info.subject: Support Request – Connector Unavailability on Charging Station léSicharge D Y2 / S2313522141002
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Support Team,
I hope this message finds you well. I’m kindly reaching out to request your assistance regarding an issue with the charging station le Sicharge D Y2 / S2313522141002.
One of the connectors currently appears to be unavailable. Additionally, the client has reported some irregular behavior from the station, including a case where a truck was only charged up to 40%, after which the charging session unexpectedly stopped.
At this point, we are still in the process of collecting more detailed information, including the exact times these issues occurred.
In the meantime, we would greatly appreciate it if your team could carry out a preliminary check on the station’s status, to help us better understand the situation and prepare a more detailed report next week.
Thank you very much in advance for your support and assistance.
Best regards,
Malek DRIF | Head of Operations | Mob:
+33 650 370 485
SAS AUTORECHARGE |
WWW.AUTORECHARGE.FR
|

Design and installation of EV charging equipment and infrastructure

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0419712-DC/Si-D/FR-{Y2 / S2 313522141002}Connector is unavailable CRM:02681000096
additional_info.body:
Hello Malek,
We would like to inform you that the charger was temporarily unavailable due to the following reasons:
The EVSE was not in operating mode (Run)
A scheduled software update was performed
The system underwent a reboot
These actions have now been completed, and we’re pleased to confirm that the charger is back online and operating normally.
Regarding the charging session interruption you mentioned, kindly share the exact timestamp of the issue. Once we receive this information, we will analyze the system logs and get back to you with the detailed findings.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Ankita
